messages:
maria.prod: Quick question — for the v1->v2 deprecation flow, do we require explicit tenant consent before we start routing their requests to the v2 fallback? thinking about legal/enterprise needs + console UX.

devin.eng: Short answer: some enterprise contracts want explicit opt-in/out. Operational plan was a soft roll (canary + opt-in) that prefers non-disruptive fallbacks.

sam.console: From UX POV we can add a per-tenant toggle 'Allow automatic compatibility routing' with a tooltip. Show last 30d % routed to v2 and projected cost delta if they flip.

kevin.sre: When we route to v2 we sometimes see different token profiles and higher downstream retries. Need to protect tenant quotas and avoid surprise billing spikes. Propose a temporary grace-quota buffer for 7 days after first routing change.

maria.prod: Product wants explicit consent for enterprise-flagged tenants; for self-serve surface an opt-in banner and default to conservative (no auto-switch) until opt-in.

devin.eng: Routing policy should respect three states: explicit_opt_in, explicit_opt_out, default_control (our soft-roll). Add audit log event so we can prove consent was respected.

sam.console: UX nit: make the toggle actionable from route overview and include a timeline of when traffic was routed + reason. Also add a preview button to sample responses from both variants.

kevin.sre: Telemetry: need compact event for each decision with deterministic sampling for high-volume routes. Example schema:
{ event: "compat_routing_decision", tenant_id: "T123", client_version: "v1.4.2", route: "/generate", applied_policy: "explicit_opt_in", reason: "consent_toggle", decision_ts: 1689000000 }
Include optional token_estimate and projected_quota_impact.

maria.prod: Also include 'consent_provenance' to capture how consent was given (console, contract, support).

devin.eng: Emit full events to internal telemetry (high-cardinality) and sampled summaries to metrics: counters per policy + histograms for latency/cost. Sampling key should use tenant_id hash for deterministic sampling.

kevin.sre: Billing: need non-sampled trail for disputes. Suggest raw events to cold storage for 90 days (audit window) + sampled metrics for dashboards. Schema should be versioned.

sam.console: UX detail: when tenant flips to allow automatic routing, show interstitial listing expected cost delta, SLA impact, and opt-out link. Keep reversible.

maria.prod: Decision: default = conservative (no auto-switch for self-serve). Expose opt-in banner + console toggle. Enterprise flagged accounts require explicit sign-off recorded as consent_provenance=contract. Routing layer must respect explicit state and emit compat_routing_decision events.

devin.eng: I'll stub routing-flag schema + telemetry producer PR. Need SRE to define audit retention and storage path.

kevin.sre: I will own retention plan. Opening infra ticket for cold storage + dispute query tooling. Event schema will be versioned.

rollout-bot: Scheduled canary: 2025-07-10T03:00:00Z, cohort=10% self-serve tenants, policy=default_control. Will notify #incidents if error-rate delta > 2x baseline.

maria.prod: Thanks — can we get a short checklist before the canary? items: console toggle UI, consent_provenance capture, telemetry event v1, cold-storage retention ticket, grace-quota policy draft.

devin.eng: On it — will post PR links + checklist by EOD tomorrow.
